name: preview-pane-tall
for: A preview taller than the runtime will draw: it clamps the pane to 24 lines and paints a divider row where it cut. The pane is 27 rows and the whole dialog more than promptScanDepth, so option 1 — on the pane's top row — fell out of the scan window and a session blocked on the dialog read as IDLE, not waiting_input. Pins that the window is widened to the pane's top, that the divider row belongs to the pane, and that a tall dialog still reads as a prompt.
redactedFrom: real capture, redacted by corpus-redact (one runtime build, 2026-09-25); the labels and preview text were synthetic to begin with
